comparison.objective: Cut a taped carton open, return the cutter, open its flaps, and retrieve the item.
comparison.physical_skill: Guarded cutting, bimanual flap articulation, and contents extraction.
comparison.success_condition: All required tape cuts, tool return, flap opening, and item placement completed; exact score tiers are absent.
comparison.reason: Carton opening and retrieval are mechanically unrelated to stop calibration and jam-nut locking.
